Hi team,

Thanks again for taking time to speak with Amina yesterday. Quick packet attached — I included the candidate's brief, the interview kit, and a blank scorecard template (amina_scorecard_template.xlsx).

High-level: strong systems thinking, clearly led infra tradeoffs in prior role at Brightly. Comfortable with ambiguity but we heard a couple of soft spots on product prioritization in the final panel. Candidate is interested in the IC+PM-adjacent role you described.

Can you each drop a one-paragraph take + numeric score on the attached scorecard by EOD Friday? Hiring manager (Rafi) wants to know whether we should advance to hiring-manager loop or pass. If you prefer, paste the numeric row into your reply so we can aggregate quickly.

Attaching: amina_rahman_interview-kit.pdf, amina_scorecard_template.xlsx

—Sam

Jonas / team — posting my scores inline to make aggregation easier. Attaching my short notes (marissa_notes_amina.txt).

Numeric row (Tech | System Design | Product | Communication | Culture) = 4 | 4 | 3 | 5 | 4

Quick rationale:
- Technical / System Design: Asked for example on cache invalidation at scale; candidate provided pragmatic tradeoffs and a sensible rollout plan. Confident in infra chops.
- Product: Hesitated on how to prioritize telemetry vs. new feature work; gave reasonable answers but not proactive about metrics.
- Communication: Clear, good story arcs, comfortable raising open questions.

Recommend: advance to hiring-manager loop if Rafi can probe product prioritization; not a hard pass.

Numeric row (Tech | System Design | Product | Communication | Culture) = 3 | 4 | 2 | 4 | 4

Notes:
- Tech: solid fundamentals; took a beat on an edge-case scaling question (circuit-breaker stress), but recovery plan looked OK.
- Product: I agree with Marissa — Amina gives pragmatic answers but doesn't drive a prioritization framework spontaneously. That's more of a PM tilt than a straight SWE expectation for this role.

Given Marissa's 4/3 on product and my 2/3 split, I'm neutral-lean-yes only if the hiring-manager loop will dig into product sense. If Rafi is comfortable validating through one focused HM conversation, move forward. If we need stronger product thinking, we should pass.

Action items:
- Jonas to aggregate and post GH record: GH-12345 (link above).
- If majority yes, Sam: please schedule HM loop with Rafi for next week (30–45m). If not, we close the candidate with constructive feedback.

—Tessa
